'''January 2001 Knoxville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in KGB, Knoxville, TN in January 2001. [[Clint Hays]] won it. It is known from Clint Hays's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1697">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-02-kgb-holed1697/ kgb-hole], DeckTech (Clint "GameMaster" Hays, 2 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-02-kgb-holed1697/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' January 2001
* '''Site:''' KGB, Knoxville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Clint Hays]]
